verdict.line: You lose if you let him land a clean Q-into-E all-in before level 6 or get caught by The Show Stopper with W down; you win if you poke from Parrrley range and punish every window his Q and E are both on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Gangplank's 625-range Parrrley and Grog-Soaked Blade poison let him whittle a melee duelist who has zero ranged answer, but Sett's Q (Knuckle Down) gives him the move speed to close that gap and his E (Facebreaker) threatens a stun the moment Gangplank gets sandwiched against a minion. The 283-game sample's 51.9% head-to-head and the 'solo-kill advantage: Sett' tag both point to the same thing: the poke war is close, but his burst windows are the bigger threat.

theirWindow.when: Q and E both off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He can close the gap with Knuckle Down's move speed and lock you down with Facebreaker's stun. Stay outside 490 range and never stand on the opposite side of a minion from him or you eat the stun instead of the weaker slow.

yourWindow.when: Q and E both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no tool to close distance or lock you in place. Walk up and chain Parrrley plus autos freely — the poison from Grog-Soaked Blade keeps ticking even if he disengages.

start.why: Run in 70.5% of games at 50.8% win rate — the extra sustain offsets Sett's passive health regen scaling off his missing HP during the early poke war.

boots.why: 51.3% win rate over 113 games. Sett's damage is built on alternating empowered autos (Pit Grit) and Haymaker's physical-damage sides, so flat auto-attack mitigation blunts him harder than lifesteal does.

core.why: First item in the highest-performing path (57.4% win rate, 47 games). The mana refund keeps Parrrley spammable through the poke war without running dry.
Second in that same 57.4% WR path. The execute threshold turns your poison-plus-Parrrley chip damage into real kills once he's low.
Completes the 57.4% WR, 19.3%-pick build. Crit scaling lets you out-duel him in extended fights once items come online.

situational.when: sett builds into health-stacking tank items and your crit damage is getting soaked
you need more survivability through his all-in burst windows around level 6-8
the enemy team is stacking shields that are blunting your burst

runes.keystoneWhy: Deathfire Touch's burn stacks on top of Grog-Soaked Blade's poison, rewarding the poke pattern this lane wants — hit him with Parrrley and autos from range, then walk away before his Q/E window opens.

summoners.why: Run in 88.4% of games at 48.4% win rate. Ignite closes out trades where Sett's passive health regen off missing HP would otherwise let him sustain through your poke.

playing.title: Poke at max Parrrley range
playing.detail: Q (Parrrley, 625 range, 5s cooldown) lets you harass from outside Facebreaker's 490 range entirely. Stay there and he has no way to answer it.

playing.title: Respect the level 3-5 E all-in
playing.detail: Once Facebreaker is up, don't stand on the opposite side of a minion from him — that's what turns his pull into a stun instead of just a slow.

playing.title: Watch his stored Grit before trading
playing.detail: Haymaker (W) dumps all his stored Grit into a bigger shield and punch. If he's been tanking poke or minion hits, expect a bigger hit than usual and don't commit full HP into it.

playing.title: Hold W for his R, not for sustain
playing.detail: Once he's level 6, save Remove Scurvy (22-18s cooldown by rank) to cleanse the crowd control from The Show Stopper and heal off the slam, rather than popping it early just to sustain through poke.

playing.title: Punish empty Q/E windows hard
playing.detail: When Knuckle Down and Facebreaker are both down, he can't close distance or lock you down. Walk up and stack Parrrley casts plus poison autos freely.

playing.title: Rush Essence Reaver first
playing.detail: The mana refund keeps your Parrrley spam going through the whole laning phase instead of forcing recalls — this is the first item in the 57.4% win-rate path.

playing.title: Use Ignite to end trades, not start them
playing.detail: His passive regen scales up as he goes low, so Ignite is what actually secures the kill once you've chunked him with Parrrley and poison.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoner spells, and all win-rate/sample figures come from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability interactions, timing windows, and power-curve reads are my own tactical judgment layered on top of that data.
